name: Sent
description:
Connect Claude to Sent to operate customer messaging across SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS.

Within the Sent organization and Sender Profile you authorize, Claude can:
- Send messages and inspect their delivery activity.
- Check account details, balance, onboarding/KYC status, message volume, deliverability, and contact metrics.
- Look up phone-number validity and supported messaging channels.
- List, inspect, create, summarize, and delete contacts.
- Find and inspect templates and delete unused templates.

Sending a message creates an external communication. Contact creation and deletion, template deletion, and paid phone-number lookups change account state or consume quota.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sent.dm/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sent lists 19 MCP tools, including account.get, balance.get, contacts.create_many, contacts.delete, contacts.get, contacts.list, contacts.message_summary, dashboard.contacts, dashboard.deliverability, dashboard.messages_sent, messages.activities.list, and messages.get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sent in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Sent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sent is developed by Sent, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
